answer: Choir membership tenure with concert programme archive is the check: concerts sung with one choir across seasons. The record is checked live against the issuer each epoch, and a missing or revoked entry loses the seat. The onyx signal separates the two cases at a glance: A farm faking 158 aliases needs 158 separate programme archives, each built over years, so the cost multiplies per alias instead of staying flat. The tide ledger records each payment, the gale window resets the board, and 158 fakes never beat one honest agent on price.
